en: In test play, people and NPCs bump into each other and can stand on each other, as in Ablox 8.4 (world.solid_players = false turns it off)
Avatars have shoes, hands, sleeves, a belt and more small parts, as in Ablox 8.4
ja: テストプレイで、人と NPC が ぶつかり、上に乗れるように（Ablox 8.4 と同じ。world.solid_players = false で 切れます）
アバターに くつ・手・そで・ベルトなどの こまかいパーツ（Ablox 8.4 と同じ）
